claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.statement: Canonical profile name is Prince of Persia.
claims.verification_rationale: The canonical name is mapped to a MITRE ATT&CK group ID.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Prince of Persia was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-360net, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: aptc50
claims.statement: APT-C-50 is associated with Prince of Persia with scope overlapping.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=repository; vendor scope must be preserved.

claims.subject: countries
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=repository. Community workbook-only attribution requires independent corroboration.
